title: APPLICATION FOR DESIGNATION AS A REGIONAL CARDIO-CEREBROVASCULAR DISEASE CENTER
full_text:
APPLICATION FOR DESIGNATION AS A REGIONAL CARDIO-CEREBROVASCULAR DISEASE CENTER
Form No. 3 attached to the Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Prevention and Management of Cardio-Cerebrovascular Diseases <Newly inserted on June 22, 2023>

The applicant institution must not complete the shaded fields.

Receipt number: __________
Date received: __________
Processing period: 2 months

Medical institution
Name: __________
Type of medical institution: __________
Healthcare institution number: __________
Address: __________
Telephone number: __________
Name of representative: __________
License number: __________
Medical specialties offered: __________
Number of licensed beds: __________

Regional cardio-cerebrovascular disease center
Name of representative: __________
License number: __________
Name of person responsible for practical affairs: __________
Telephone number: __________

I hereby apply for designation as a regional cardio-cerebrovascular disease center as stated above under Article 13 of the Act on the Prevention and Management of Cardio-Cerebrovascular Diseases and Article 7 of its Enforcement Rule.

Year: ____  Month: ____  Day: ____
Applicant: ____________________ (Signature or seal)

To: Minister of Health and Welfare

Documents to attach
1. Documents proving compliance with the designation criteria in Annex 2 to the Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Prevention and Management of Cardio-Cerebrovascular Diseases.
2. Current status of personnel deployment.
3. Operational plan.

Fee: None.

Processing procedure
1. Preparation of application — Applicant.
2. Receipt — Ministry of Health and Welfare.
3. Review — Ministry of Health and Welfare.
4. Approval — Ministry of Health and Welfare.
5. Issue of designation certificate — Ministry of Health and Welfare.

210 mm × 297 mm [White paper, 80 g/m² (recycled material)]
